name: JailJudge
intro: JailJudge 是一个可解释的越狱裁判基准与训练框架。它从六类有害提示和多种安全/不安全模型回答构建 35K+ 条训练数据，并提供 4.5K+ 条广泛风险 ID 测试数据与十种语言 6K+ 条 OOD 测试数据。JailJudge MultiAgent 通过初判、证据聚合、投票和最终推理产生解释与 1–10 分，再用于训练无需 API 的 JAILJUDGE Guard。
org: HKUST (Guangzhou), University of Birmingham, Baidu, HKUST
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成, 多智能体蒸馏
metric: 准确率, 精确率, 召回率, F1, 解释质量（EQ）
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
task_type: 越狱裁判, 二元分类, 细粒度评分
eval_feature: 对抗性, 多语言, 可解释
task_type_en: Jailbreak Judging, Binary Classification, Fine-grained Scoring
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Automated Generation, Multi-agent Distillation
intro_en: JailJudge is an explainable jailbreak-judge benchmark and training framework. It builds 35K+ training items from six harmful-prompt sources and diverse safe/unsafe model responses, with a 4.5K+ broad-risk ID test set and a 6K+ ten-language OOD test set. JailJudge MultiAgent produces explanations and 1–10 scores through judging, evidence aggregation, voting, and final inference, then supervises the API-free JAILJUDGE Guard.
metric_en: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, Explainability Quality (EQ)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.12855 Sections 3–5 and Appendices 8–12 plus official repository snapshot 8743c13. The diagram separates human-labeled JAILJUDGETEST from MultiAgent-generated training ground truth, preserves the 35K+/4.5K+/6K+ scales and ten-language OOD design, and reports judge classification plus explainability metrics rather than treating downstream attack ASR as the benchmark's primary metric.
